Painting a room is one of the cheapest ways to change how your home looks and feels. But the price can vary a lot depending on the size of the room, the paint you choose and whether you do it yourself or hire someone. In this article we look at how much it costs to paint a room and what makes the price go up or down. Average Cost to Paint a Room

For a normal bedroom of about 12 by 12 feet, most homeowners in the US pay between $300 and $800 to have a professional painter do the walls. If you paint the room yourself, you will usually spend around $100 to $250 on paint and supplies. Bigger rooms, high ceilings and lots of trim will push the price up. Many painters charge by the square foot of wall area, while others give a fixed price per room. Always ask what is included, for example moving furniture, repairing small holes, painting the ceiling and cleaning up afterwards.

What Affects the Cost

Several things change the final price of a paint job:
  • The size of the room and the height of the ceiling
  • The number of coats needed, especially when you go from a dark colour to a light one
  • The quality of the paint, as premium paint costs more per gallon but often covers better
  • How much preparation is needed, such as filling cracks, sanding and priming
  • Extra surfaces like doors, window frames, skirting boards and the ceiling
Older homes can also need extra care. If your house was built before 1978, the old paint may contain lead, and sanding it can be dangerous. The EPA lead information page explains the rules and the safe way to handle it.

DIY vs Hiring a Painter

Painting a room yourself is cheaper, but it takes time and some skill to get clean lines and an even finish. A professional painter works faster, brings the right tools and usually gives a better result, especially on ceilings and trim. If you are on a tight budget, a good middle way is to do the preparation work yourself and hire a painter only for the final coats. You can compare this with other home projects in our guide to interior painting costs.

How to Save Money

There are a few simple ways to keep the cost down. Get at least three quotes from local painters and compare what each one includes. Buy good paint, because cheap paint often needs an extra coat. Paint in the quieter months, when some painters offer lower prices. Finally, move the furniture and clear the room yourself so the painter can start straight away.

FAQ

How long does it take to paint a room?

Most average bedrooms take one to two days for one person, including drying time between coats. A professional team can often finish a room in a single day.

Do I need to use primer?

You need primer when you paint over bare plaster, new drywall, stains or a much darker colour. On walls that are already painted in good condition, a paint with built-in primer is often enough.

Is it cheaper to paint a room yourself?

Yes, doing it yourself is usually much cheaper because you only pay for paint and supplies. You do need to count the value of your own time and the cost of any tools you have to buy.
